dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a gentle concave curvature from the posterior base to the apex, following a smooth spline with moderate inward deviation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-rounded geometry with a small pixel radius, indicating a sharp but slightly blunted highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin steepness is approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1:1.15.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex melon arc with a medium-sized radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust beak with high pixel thickness relative to its short visible length extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 165 degrees at the point where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple dark, circular punctate markings or pits are visible on the lateral surface of the head and melon region; possible focal lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast white/light-toned patch on the dorsal midline anterior to the fin; visible white dental line at the mouth gape.
